title: leucosedum hirsutum
intro: Leucosedum hirsutum, commonly known as the woolly mint, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Leucosedum hirsutum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as menthone, limonene, and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
